Say hello to Counties EnergyEnergy ReimaginedKo mātou tēnei – our
organisation
At Counties Energy, our purpose is to power thriving communities by unlocking
the full energy potential of the region to secure a sustainable and prosperous

JD example

15


future for generations to come.
As a 100% community owned electricity distributor, we deliver safe and reliable
power to nearly 50,000 homes and businesses from south Auckland to the top
of the Waikato.
Ko tō tūranga – your role
In the newly created Data and AI Engineer role, you will enable data‑driven,
defensible decision‑making for Counties Energy and our customers. This role
sits in our Asset Strategy & Performance team who are responsible for
developing and implementing strategies to optimise the performance, reliability,
and longevity of the company’s assets, setting performance targets and
support decision-making to ensure the organisation’s infrastructure meets
current and future needs efficiently and sustainably. This role is key to
providing the expertise on analysing network and asset data and supporting the
use of AI‑enabled tools to improve asset management effectiveness.
Working alongside other data professionals in the Network Development and
Digital Operations teams, you’ll help drive smarter, evidence‑based decisions
across the asset lifecycle, including planning, investment prioritisation,
maintenance, and performance monitoring. Working closely with asset
managers, engineers, and business teams, you will turn complex data into clear
insights, strengthen data quality and accessibility, and support more reliable,
cost‑effective outcomes for our communities.
Ōu pūkenga - What will you bring?
A relevant NZ tertiary qualification in data science, engineering science,
computer science or statistics.
Minimum 2 years of experience in data centric roles or equivalent post
graduate experience.
Strong experience in Excel, Power Query, SQL, Python and PowerBI is
essential.
Experience with Jupyter and data science libraries / frameworks like
NumPy, SciPy,and Keras and/or PyTorch
Experience working with Snowflake, Graph or Geographic datasets and
working end to end with big data pipelines is an advantage.
A keen interest in the distribution of electricity/energy networks, and a
desire to improve them to better serve our customers (experience in the

JD example

16


energy sector an advantage, but not a necessary)
Curious and inquisitive mindset; seeks out different and conflicting
perspectives to shape strong, data-backed conclusions.
Resilient and tenacious; adaptable to changing demands and conditions
and looks for opportunities to improve the current state.
Numerate and analytical; highly organised and methodical and makes
decisions based on facts and analysis.
Able to work autonomously and being self-driven to produce good quality
outcomes in a timely manner.
At Counties Energy, we value a growth mindset, so if you have most of these
skills or characteristics in your toolbox, we encourage you to apply.
Nā mātou te rourou – what you’ll receive
Based in Pukekohe, we have a great culture that is fun, friendly, and supportive,
you’ll quickly see why working with us is something special.
Health, life, and income protection insurance
$300 wellbeing subsidy
Enhanced paid partner’s leave
Training and development opportunities
Relocation packages
Plus, after 12 months, you’ll also receive:
Increased company KiwiSaver Contribution to 4%,
A paid ‘Me Day’ for you, to use as you choose and,
An extra five days of sick leave.
Me pēhea te tono - How to apply?
If you’re based in Aotearoa New Zealand with relevant work rights and are
willing to undergo our pre-employment medical check and drug test, we look
forward to receiving your application including CV and cover letter
by Thursday 23 April 2026.
Applications may be reviewed as they are received. Early applications are
encouraged.

Find out more about us
As one of New Zealand’s most progressive energy companies, we power
everything from homes and businesses, through to new tech innovations and
life-changing ideas. But we’re more than just power – we’re a technology and
energy business, and as Aotearoa New Zealand transitions to a low carbon
future, we’ll continue to lead change to be fully prepared for what’s next.
Based in Pukekohe, our sights are set nationwide for our future. With an asset
base of $577m and revenue of $171m per year, our people at Counties Energy
number over 200, while our subsidiary ECL Group, a technology and energy
solutions company which spans the country, employs around 300 staff.
Our network is evolving and growing at one of the fastest rates in the country.
We’re seeking great talent to build, plan and maintain this growth.

Find out more about us and our journey towards our new energy future –
countiesenergy.co.nz.

Employer questions

Zealand?
Do you consent to Counties Energy verifying your immigration status with
Immigration New Zealand?
